versions.changelog: 无文件写入修复：push-toggle 不再写 data/users（cron 自持调度状态），morning/evening-push 移除无用的用户档案读取；补充 .clawhubignore。符合 clawhub 无 fs 写入规范。

- Clarified and shortened the skill description for better readability.
- No core logic changes; documentation updated for clarity and conciseness.
- Added a new README.md to improve user guidance.
- No workflow or visual feature changes.

- Initial release of daily-vocab skill.
- Generates a daily advanced English vocabulary card with pronunciation, etymology, usage examples, synonyms, antonyms, and memory tips.
- Features a premium flashcard-style HTML interface with interactive study modes and theme rotation.
- Includes push notification management with scheduling and multi-channel support (Telegram, Feishu, Slack, Discord).
- Ad-ready zone and branded footer included in card layout.
